Building India's Culture-Forward Artist Ecosystem
Who We Are

The Shakti Collective is a culture-forward artist ecosystem company built to discover, develop and scale artists, stories and cultural movements.

​

Working across music, films, live experiences, learning, artist partnerships & original IPs, we create the ecosystems that help artists grow, audiences connect & culture move forward.

Artists today have more access than ever before, but building a lasting career still requires the right ecosystem.

​

TSC exists to bridge the gap between:

Talent & Opportunity

Artists & Audiences

Stories & Culture

Creativity & Sustainable Growth

Why We Exist
Our long-term vision is to serve 10 million artists and take 100 stories to the globe.
Our Beliefs
Our Vision
Artist-first.

Long-term partnerships over short-term campaigns.

Culture-forward.

Work that is meaningful, relevant, and timeless.

Rooted, yet global.

Taking Indian stories and artists to the world.

Purpose with progress.

Where creativity, culture, and business grow together.

To build the world's most trusted culture company by empowering artists & stories that create lasting cultural impact.

Conscious Entertainment. Lasting Impact.

Our Philosophy

Entertainment can be meaningful, commercially successful, and culturally relevant—all at once.

Our work follows a simple journey:

HUMAN

We discover talent, develop identities, curate experiences, launch ideas, and help artists and stories grow into lasting cultural movements.

Career Management
More than artist management, TSC Artists is a culture-forward partnership platform designed to help independent artists build sustainable careers.

From live opportunities and strategic representation to audience growth, collaborations, and career development, we work alongside artists to create journeys that are creatively fulfilling, culturally relevant, and commercially sustainable.
